Our vision in one statement

A more thoughtful dairy standard for Purvanchal.पूर्वांचल के लिए डेयरी का एक बेहतर मानक।

Starting in Ghazipur, PETERDUDHWALA aims to bring a new standard of everyday dairy consumption to Purvanchal by connecting responsible local milk sourcing with hygienic processing, reusable packaging and reliable home delivery.

We are building a dairy brand where purity is a practice, freshness is a commitment and trust is the foundation of every relationship.

A few helpful answers

Frequently asked questionsअक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल

Learn more about PETERDUDHWALA, our milk products and our approach to dairy.

What is PETERDUDHWALA?

PETERDUDHWALA is an emerging dairy brand from Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, being developed around purity, freshness and responsible dairy practices.

Where is PETERDUDHWALA based?

PETERDUDHWALA is based in Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Which milk products does PETERDUDHWALA focus on?

Our initial product focus includes cow milk and buffalo milk. Availability will depend on the launch and distribution schedule.

What is the PETERDUDHWALA philosophy?

Our philosophy is Purity & Freshness, supported by responsible sourcing, quality evaluation and careful dairy handling.

Does PETERDUDHWALA provide home delivery?

Please contact us to confirm current product availability and delivery services in your area.

How does PETERDUDHWALA approach milk quality?

Our approach focuses on responsible sourcing, quality evaluation, hygienic handling, appropriate processing and careful storage.

How can I contact PETERDUDHWALA?

The quickest way is WhatsApp: tap the green button on this page. You can also use the enquiry form on this website.

Does PETERDUDHWALA plan to expand?

Our long-term vision is to build a recognised dairy brand across India, beginning with our foundation in Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh.
